# Third-party notices

The three OpenRewrite production classes and donor StringUtils tests originate from openrewrite/rewrite 8.90.4, commit 398a6349648ca802aa050bdb6fe45a99395dce47, Apache-2.0. Original source and Apache license are retained. The adaptations affect only Java comment termination and Javadoc cursor alignment; public APIs are unchanged.

Pinned SLF4J 1.7.36 artifacts are MIT-licensed; the complete notice is retained in third_party/LICENSE-SLF4J.txt. Official dependency binary/source artifacts are bound by third_party/SHA256SUMS.

RoundScale test fixtures are unchanged Eclipse Nebula source material under their original Eclipse Public License headers. The Git LF and checkout CRLF byte identities are separately pinned and parsed without normalization. Tests compare exact printed bytes and unchanged files. The existing SnippetTooltip source remains in its original owner location and is never rewritten.
